newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit rangebound in KL on weak dlr/majors.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit rangebound in KL on weak dlr/majors.

text.p: The ringgit was rangebound towards close of trading in Kuala Lumpur as selling by foreign funds buckled under the combined pressure of a weak dollar/yen and lack of new trading factors, dealers said on Monday.
They said activity was thin, though many overseas institutions were looking to unload the ringgit.
"There are still funds looking to buy dollar/ringgit. They are only slowing down because of the weak dollar/majors," said a dealer with a U.S. bank in Singapore.
He said there was dollar demand at around 2.5090 a dollar and Malaysian institutions were lookign to sell around 2.5140.
Dealers said the ringgit eased slightly just after lunch on some fund selling, but recovered soon after.
They said the selling in the thin market had exaggerated the impact on the ringgit.
"The market is very quiet. Very little volume is going through," said a dealer with a Malaysian bank.
At 0945 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.5107/17 a dollar.
